entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The central religious text of Islam, believed by Muslims to be the word of God (Allah) revealed to Prophet Muhammad through the Angel Gabriel (610–632 CE). Comprising 114 surahs in Arabic, the Quran is the foundation of Islamic theology, jurisprudence, ethics, and Arabic literary culture. It has been memorized, recited, and transmitted with meticulous care for over 1,400 years and shapes the lives of nearly 2 billion people.
